description: This Java class provides utility methods for working with URLs, resources, and files within the Apache OFBiz framework. It offers functions to load resources as URLs, handle classpath resources, local files, and environment-specific paths, and manage URL caching.

classes.name: UtilURL
classes.description: A utility class for fetching and manipulating URLs and resources in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods to load resources relative to classes, files, URLs, and system properties, with internal caching for efficiency.

methods.name: fromClass
methods.description: Constructs a URL pointing to the properties resource associated with a given class.

methods.name: fromResource (String)
methods.description: Loads a resource as a URL given its resource name.

methods.name: fromResource (Class, String)
methods.description: Loads a resource as a URL relative to a specified class's class loader.

methods.name: fromResource (String, ClassLoader)
methods.description: Loads a resource as a URL using a specified class loader, with internal caching.

methods.name: fromFilename
methods.description: Creates a URL from a local filename if the file exists.

methods.name: fromUrlString
methods.description: Creates a URL object from a string URL representation.

methods.name: fromOfbizHomePath
methods.description: Constructs a URL from a path relative to the OFBIZ home directory based on a system property.

methods.name: getOfbizHomeRelativeLocation
methods.description: Returns the relative path of a URL with respect to the OFBIZ home directory.
